acceptance: Independent review required; no complete_work call.

after.denial: Voice requires the private desktop bootstrap authority.
after.note: The original success-oriented probe aborts at the intended denial; finally closes service and deletes disposable data. No probe source edits.

p1.provisioning: Random per-service private OS file, mode 0600, service owner nonce binding, never in public descriptor or RPC response. Electron main reads it directly. Service restart rotates it; successful shutdown removes it.
p1.verification: Private proof is required for trusted registration and every trusted lease operation. Public ID cannot reacquire a trusted lease. Legacy nonvoice registration cannot mint voice ownership. Expiry, replacement and restart revoke previous lease/owner proofs.
p1.recovery: All native and voice operations bypass server recovery records/results. Public status, generic events, audit, descriptors and tested command records exclude proof, trusted lease, owner handle and fake SDP.
p1.fileBoundary: Protected inode rejects application preview/read/write, workflow File/Skill reads and Git diff reads, including tested hardlink/symlink aliases. Bootstrap excluded by existing backup whitelist.
p1.limit: Does not resist arbitrary same-OS-user private file/process access or authorized arbitrary command/code execution. No general user/account auth migration.

p2.permission: speaker-selection checks and requests both validate owning desktop contents, top frame and trusted URL. Checks additionally validate requesting security origin; packaged file origin is distinct from full requestingUrl.
p2.tests: Trusted/foreign/null contents, subframes, foreign origin, navigated owners and packaged origins. All device/OS APIs mocked.

freeze.contract: Frozen host rejects prepare/start/appends. Stop/snapshot and lifecycle cleanup remain callable. Check repeats after async native start metadata before native start/input.
freeze.tests: Prepared frozen session rejects start and all three append handlers with voice_host_frozen and zero native calls; pending start metadata cannot cross freeze; failed shutdown still permits explicit cleanup retry.
